paper_title: A SQUID-based microwave cavity search for dark-matter axions
notes: ADMX SQUID-amplifier run excludes KSVZ axion dark matter over 3.3-3.53 ueV at 90% CL with rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3. The exclusion is presented as a coupling curve in Fig. 5, but no numerical coupling values are given in the text. The emitted coupling value ~1e-15 GeV^-1 is an approximate KSVZ-level placeholder and is NOT reliably extracted; only the mass range is well-defined.
